measurement: E_GABA in layer II/III pyramidal cells of knockout, heterozygote and wild-type littermates by a method that leaves chloride unclamped (gramicidin perforated patch with agonist application, with resting potential; the integrity check of the perforation reported); somatic first, axon initial segment if feasible.
separates: E-chloride from the rest; sets the sign of GABA at rest and at the burst-relevant potential.
cannot_separate: Which transporter or channel (needs a transporter manipulation); the release or receptor causes; the compartment if only somatic.
control_for_null: Same-day positive control (rupture shifts E_Cl to the pipette value; a transporter manipulation moves E_Cl in wild type); age-matched wild type; 10-30 min stability as in the reference method (source fact P08).
unit_of_replication: animal (litter where applicable); cells nested; a mixed model or per-animal means
design_choice_not_finding: which ages (a window of ages is a design choice); that somatic E_GABA represents dendrites; the number of agonist applications per cell

measurement: Age series of knockout, heterozygote and wild-type littermates for sIPSC (M03), E_GABA (M01), KCC2/NKCC1 protein and tonic current, across the ages the knockouts survive (they die at 3-4 weeks, P06).
separates: E-maturation from a persistent difference; E-compensation from a primary one (an age before bursting).
cannot_separate: Mechanism within an age; ages beyond survival; a cause of the timing.
control_for_null: Wild-type littermate at every age; the same method at every age (the internal chloride, temperature and analysis fixed); at least two ages on each side of P13-P17 if animals allow.
design_choice_not_finding: the ages; that a younger age lacks bursts; the reference ages from other regions (P08 P09 P10) are not this slice

measurement: Re-record sIPSC with glutamate-receptor block, the physiological-chloride internal and the high-chloride internal in the same preparation, a fixed absolute detection threshold and noise reported, access resistance per genotype; per-animal summary.
separates: E-artefact from a real amplitude change; amplitude under physiological chloride compared with the clamped value.
control_for_null: Blind to genotype; the high-chloride internal kept as the bridge to the published value (57.3 and 27.5 pA, P03); a null means the artefact is not the whole effect.
design_choice_not_finding: the threshold; whether both internals can be applied in the same cell or only in matched cells

measurement: mIPSC (TTX, glutamate-receptor block, GABA-A block at the end to confirm identity): amplitude distribution, frequency, rise and decay.
separates: E-response (amplitude, kinetics) from E-supply (frequency); E-supply by filling shows as amplitude and is not separated here.
cannot_separate: Release probability from site number; filling from receptor number.
control_for_null: The paired mEPSC under the same conditions (P05: mEPSC amplitude is higher, P03 context); stable-recording windows as the mEPSC analysis used.
design_choice_not_finding: the cut-off for a quantal event; pooling across cells in a KS test (do not)

measurement: Direct agonist response under TTX (puff or uncaging at a fixed distance) with physiological chloride.
cannot_separate: Synaptic from extrasynaptic receptors unless the site is controlled; chloride unless M01 is paired.
control_for_null: Same pipette geometry, distance and cell size; a positive control that the puff gives a response in wild type; cell size and input resistance (Table 1, P04).
design_choice_not_finding: agonist concentration and duration are design choices

measurement: Evoked IPSC: input-output, failure rate, paired-pulse ratio, and the E/I ratio in the same cell (at holding potentials set by the physiological internal).
control_for_null: Stimulus site and intensity fixed in absolute terms; glutamate-receptor block for IPSC isolation; a time-matched vehicle for any drug arm.
design_choice_not_finding: the stimulus site; the isolation of monosynaptic IPSCs

measurement: Tonic GABA-A current: holding-current shift on GABA-A block with and without GABA-uptake block and a fixed ambient-GABA condition.
control_for_null: Block agent alone; condition fixed because tonic current depends on uptake and ambient GABA (P12: 170 against 12 pA; 9 against 41 pA).
design_choice_not_finding: which ambient-GABA and uptake condition; what counts as change

measurement: Interneuron identity and number per animal in layer II/III: PV, SST and VIP markers, GAD65/67 and VGAT, with a reporter line if available.
separates: Interneuron loss within E-supply and the identity of the recorded cells (P04).
control_for_null: Age-matched wild type; a null does not exclude lost release (pair with M06).

measurement: Wild-type slices driven into a burst state, with the M03 sIPSC readout and M07.
control_for_null: Matched burst rate and the same state conditions measured (S3 section 4 item 1).
design_choice_not_finding: how the burst state is driven; whether it resembles the knockout burst

measurement: Matched non-GABAergic suppression of bursts titrated to the same percent of evoked synaptic charge removed, carried from S3 arm A6, for any drug arm of Q5.
separates: Whether a GABA-A or chloride-directed burst reduction is more than a generic cut in drive.
cannot_separate: Which mechanism within the GABA-A arm.
control_for_null: Quantified on two metrics (charge; peak or slope); time-matched vehicle and washout where the tool reverses.
blocks_which_explanation: E-artefact for drug arms; makes Q5 rows interpretable
design_choice_not_finding: the matching metric; the common axis
